heading: One person, writing the stories I wish existed.
body:
I'm a Political Science & Philosophy student at the University of Ottawa in my undergrad year and a aspiring law school student— with the privilege to work inside the rooms where policy actually gets made, on Parliament Hill. The news gets written *about* my generation, rarely for us, and almost never by someone who has to live with the results.

So this is my version: original writing on the politics, policy, trade, climate, and ideas shaping us — reported through a fresh lens, from someone who's in the room, in plain language, with receipts.
closer: Independent. No VC, no algorithm, no team of ghostwriters. Just me.
quote: I'm not a demographic to be solved. Neither are you. We're the people who have to actually live in the world these decisions build — so we should be the ones writing about it.
